blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Two-time Olympic gold medalist Carlos Yulo advanced to three apparatus finals–floor exercise, parallel bars and vault–and the team event in the 2026 Asian Games men’s artistic gymnastics competition despite a shaky qualification round Monday. His younger brother, Karl Eldrew, meanwhile, advanced to two apparatus finals–floor exercise and horizontal bar–plus the team event. Carlos topped his pet event, floor exercise, with a score of 14.600. He also qualified for the parallel bars final in sixth place with 14.266 and advanced to the vault final despite a stumble, […]...
